in_marathi.name: Vedh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vedh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Vedh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vidh', which means 'to know'. It is a name that signifies knowledge, wisdom, and understanding. The name is also associated with the Vedas, the ancient Hindu scriptures, and is believed to bring blessings of learning and enlightenment.
